We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon signals (~10-30 ppm). We need to count distinct methyl groups.

We need to run proton NMR. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but no args). Probably uses sample at hand. So call it.
